topic: CoinStats versus Delta for precious metals tracking

reel.instagram:
CoinStats and Delta can help organize investment data, but neither reviewed official source establishes automatic physical bullion tracking. Keep coins and bars in a custody inventory, and label ETFs or mining shares as market proxies.

#Silver #Investing #PortfolioTracking
reel.x: CoinStats documents manual and crypto portfolio workflows. Delta documents read-only tracking for stocks, funds, ETFs, crypto, and wallets. Keep physical bullion in a separate inventory.
reel.facebook: CoinStats and Delta describe market portfolio tracking. Physical silver needs a separate record of item identity, invoices, storage and custody. https://fuseddistribution.com/blog/coinstats-vs-delta-for-precious-metals-tracking/
